items.label: The Latest Threaded Fixation Structure
items.value: The GJQ peony cage can be easily inserted into the ground, allowing tall flowers to grow upright without toppling over, providing reliable support for the flowers and protecting the plants from strong winds and heavy rain, ensuring that your carefully cultivated plants thrive! The dark green peony cage can be well hidden among the plants and is an excellent addition to your garden, providing a beautiful and practical support system for the plants.

items.label: Absolutely Sturdy
items.value: GJQ peony cages and supports are installed with screw threads. Each set of peony cage consists of a circular mesh top and four legs, which guide the growth direction of stems and leaves more effectively and prevent lodging. The anti-rust steel core and dark green plastic powder coating have strong weather resistance and can be reused. Thicker 3.8-4.5mm iron wire, which will not deform or bend, provides long-lasting support and protection for heavy and large outdoor plants.

items.label: Higher Size
items.value: Each peony cage consists of a circular grid ring top with a diameter of 30 cm /11.8 inches and four support legs with a height of 50 cm / 19.7inches. The circular grid top is very suitable for planting dense garden plants and effectively provides support for individual flower stems. Protect plants from strong winds, heavy rain or heavy flowering on their own. Suitable for most outdoor shrubs and vines, ensure they grow upright and vigorous with the help of garden support hoops.

items.label: Simple Assembly and Storage
items.value: Align the threads of the four support rods with the nuts on the flower tray and screw them in. Then adjust the position of the flower stems so that they are interspersed within the grid rings of the flower tray. Finally, insert the support rods into the soil and adjust them to the appropriate height. GJQ peony support provides sufficient support for heavy plants, flowers and shrubs.

items.label: The True Garden Keeper
items.value: No more huge peony bushes fall because of weight, these peony cages are also suitable for other large outdoor plants such as hydrangeas, lilies, roses, vegetables. Peony support has a significant function of supporting and protecting the healthy growth of plants. It provides the necessary support for flowers and plants in the early stage of the growing season, enabling them to grow taller and straighter, maintain an elegant and upright shape, and prevent them from falling.
